No Future Roof Deck or Railing & conditional use & The Project Sponsor shall not include any future roof deck or railing atop the fourth floor addition. \emph{(2018, p.~13, \href{https://citypln-m-extnl.sfgov.org/External/link.ashx?Action=Download\&ObjectVersion=-1\&vault=\%7bA4A7DACD-B0DC-4322-BD29-F6F07103C6E0\%7d\&objectGUID=\%7bF9081F93-FB45-4286-9213-925E897E29D0\%7d\&fileGUID=\%7bBAAF021B-31AF-46D6-A779-B8F737030CE5\%7d}{source})}\\[3pt]
Rear Decks & conditional use & The Project shall be redesigned to provide three-foot setbacks from the southern property lines to second floor balcony decks on all buildings. \emph{(2020, p.~17, \href{https://citypln-m-extnl.sfgov.org/External/link.ashx?Action=Download\&ObjectVersion=-1\&vault=\%7bA4A7DACD-B0DC-4322-BD29-F6F07103C6E0\%7d\&objectGUID=\%7bA0996D1F-468C-403B-94DA-A8E33EE72AA0\%7d\&fileGUID=\%7b78A2FA5B-AF21-43C9-A608-25E725911968\%7d}{source})}\\[3pt]
Student Housing Project & conditional use & The Project must provide all units as student housing units, as defined by California Government Code 65915 et seq., or all inclusionary housing requirements identified in Motion No. 19818 as recorded in the Notice of Special Restrictions No. 2019K737863 recorded on February 28, 2019 shall apply. \emph{(2020, p.~23, \href{https://commissions.sfplanning.org/cpcpackets/2015-004109CUA-02.pdf}{source})}\\[3pt]
Provision of a North Lightwell & conditional use & A lightwell measuring twenty-two feet in length and five feet in depth shall be provided along the north property line to mitigate impacts on the two property line windows. \emph{(2024, p.~17, \href{https://citypln-m-extnl.sfgov.org/SharedLinks.aspx?accesskey=329887a6dd6ccfda0ff116796561e3b09c2482cc02697bd0ce39e342477493cb\&VaultGUID=A4A7DACD-B0DC-4322-BD29-F6F07103C6E0}{source})}\\[3pt]
November 6, 2024 620 03rd Street 620 03RD ST Formatted & office allocation & Superscript 1. 12 \emph{(2024, p.~91, \href{https://citypln-m-extnl.sfgov.org/Commissions/CPC/11\_14\_2024/Commission\%20Packet/2022-008439OFA.pdf}{source})}\\[3pt]
Rear Yard Landscaping Plan & conditional use & Prior to Planning approval of the building permit application, the Project Sponsor shall work with Planning Staff and submit a landscaping plan to the Planning Department, that will be incorporated as ``EXHIBIT C''. \emph{(2024, p.~18, \href{https://citypln-m-extnl.sfgov.org/SharedLinks.aspx?accesskey=7e43694ef55b8ea63ec21c65ea7be89a38722f512bcc014fe9edac6220f16429\&VaultGUID=A4A7DACD-B0DC-4322-BD29-F6F07103C6E0}{source})}\\[3pt]
\bottomrule\end{longtable}}
\fi

\ifnum\pdfstrcmp{\cctab}{dictionary}=0
{\small\begin{longtable}{@{}L{3.6cm}rL{10.2cm}@{}}
\caption{\texttt{conditions\_long}: every column, with its share of rows populated (non-empty, or true for a flag) over all 91{,}720 rows, canonical or not.}\label{tab:dictionary}\\\toprule
Column & Filled & Meaning\\\midrule\endfirsthead
\toprule Column & Filled & Meaning\\\midrule\endhead
\texttt{case\_no} & 100\% & The case number the document prints (the running header's most frequent), normalised; empty where none is printed.\\
\texttt{case\_key} & 89\% & The case in the reconciled universe the row belongs to (see \texttt{case\_match}); empty where it does not resolve to exactly one.\\
\texttt{case\_stem} & 100\% & \texttt{case\_key} (else \texttt{case\_no}) with its suffix letters removed, by the shared \texttt{case\_stem}.\\
\texttt{motion\_no} & 42\% & The motion or resolution number from the title line; empty for a draft.\\
\texttt{doc\_type} & 100\% & \texttt{adopted\_motion} or \texttt{draft\_packet} (a title reading ``Draft Motion'' or a placeholder number, with no real number in the title).\\
\texttt{doc\_url} & 100\% & The first URL the document was read from; the lines cache lists every URL that served the same bytes.\\
\texttt{hearing\_date} & 99\% & ISO date from the ``Hearing Date'' line, else the date in a date-keyed URL, else the item table's date for the motion number.\\
\texttt{adoption\_date} & 41\% & ISO date from ``ADOPTED \dots\ on <date>''; empty for drafts.\\
\texttt{section\_heading} & 99\% & The standing block the condition sits under (PERFORMANCE, MONITORING, \dots; in 1998--2009 the lettered part, e.g.\ `The Approved Project').\\
\texttt{condition\_no} & 71\% & The printed number: \texttt{7}, a letter \texttt{C}, or \texttt{B(2)} for a parenthesised item under lettered part B; empty for a named, unnumbered condition or a standing block.\\
\texttt{ordinal} & 100\% & Position of the row within its motion section, from 1.\\
\texttt{heading} & 94\% & The condition's name: its bold lead-in, or a short Title Case run before the first full stop where the document has no fonts; empty where none is printed.\\
\texttt{body} & 100\% & The condition's text with the heading, running headers, footers, page numbers and the compliance line removed; lines rejoined, hyphenation undone.\\
\texttt{compliance\_contact} & 65\% & The ``For information about compliance, contact \dots'' line(s) moved out of the body.\\
\texttt{page\_start} & 100\% & Page of the source document (1-based, in the original file's numbering) where the condition starts.\\
\texttt{page\_end} & 100\% & Page where it ends.\\
\texttt{n\_chars} & 100\% & Length of \texttt{body}.\\
\texttt{has\_dollar} & 0\% & \texttt{body} contains a dollar figure.\\
\texttt{has\_percent} & 2\% & \texttt{body} contains a percentage.\\
\texttt{has\_numeric\_quantity} & 19\% & \texttt{body} contains a figure with a unit (units, feet, spaces, hours, days, months, years, a.m./p.m., seats, \dots).\\
\texttt{code\_sections\_cited} & 24\% & Planning Code sections cited, as printed, semicolon-separated.\\
\texttt{code\_sections\_norm} & 24\% & The same with the Article 4 recodification applied (\S315 $\to$ \S415 and the other pairs the motions themselves state as ``formerly'').\\
\texttt{parse\_method} & 100\% & How the start was found: \texttt{numbered}, \texttt{numbered+bold}, \texttt{numbered+text}, \texttt{bold\_heading}, \texttt{lettered}, \texttt{paren}, \texttt{section\_block}; \texttt{+ocr} when the page was OCR'd, \texttt{+ocrdigit} when an OCR-misread number was repaired.\\
\texttt{parse\_confidence} & 100\% & \texttt{high}, \texttt{medium} or \texttt{low}, by rule: low for an implausible length or an unheaded OCR row outside a numbered list; medium for OCR, implicit blocks, sequence gaps and text-read headings.\\
\texttt{part} & 100\% & \texttt{preamble} for the standing blocks before the ``Conditions of Approval, Compliance, Monitoring, and Reporting'' line; \texttt{conditions} otherwise.\\
\texttt{implicit} & 26\% & The row is a standing block with prose and no condition start (AUTHORIZATION, SEVERABILITY).\\
\texttt{sequence\_gap} & 0\% & The number skips one or two from the expected sequence.\\
\texttt{style} & 100\% & The section's numbering style: \texttt{numbered}, \texttt{bold\_heading}, \texttt{paren}, \texttt{lettered}, \texttt{unknown}.\\
\texttt{container} & 100\% & \texttt{motion} (an adopted-motion file), \texttt{packet}, or \texttt{html} (a pre-2003 motion page).\\
\texttt{embedded\_in\_packet} & 6\% & An adopted motion that is not the file's own: attached to a packet, or to a later motion that modifies it.\\
\texttt{instrument} & 100\% & \texttt{motion} or \texttt{resolution}.\\
\texttt{case\_match} & 100\% & How \texttt{case\_key} was reached: \texttt{exact}, \texttt{serial padded}, \texttt{expanded} (two-digit year), \texttt{stem} (the only case with that stem), \texttt{motion number} (the item table's case for the motion), or why not.\\
\texttt{canonical} & 92\% & The one copy of this motion section the analysis uses: a standalone file over an embedded copy, a text layer over OCR, then the fuller parse.\\
\texttt{doc\_id} & 100\% & First 16 hex digits of the document's SHA-256; names its cache files.\\
\texttt{section} & 100\% & Index of the motion section within the document, from 0.\\
\bottomrule\end{longtable}}

\fi
